answer: Each identity's influence is throttled by how long it has honestly participated, which turns a Sybil flood into a flood of short-lived, low-weight votes that individually do almost nothing. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a jetty as the anchor of the cost.
